description: Source code implementing ECDSA signature creation and verification functions, including ASN.1 encoding/decoding, for the OpenSSL cryptography library.

methods.name: ECDSA_sign
methods.description: Signs a digest using ECDSA, either via custom method or default implementation.

methods.name: ECDSA_verify
methods.description: Verifies an ECDSA signature against a digest.

methods.name: ECDSA_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of an ECDSA signature for a given key.

methods.name: ECDSA_SIG_parse
methods.description: Parses an ASN.1 encoded ECDSA signature.

methods.name: ECDSA_SIG_from_bytes
methods.description: Decodes an ECDSA signature from DER bytes.

methods.name: ECDSA_SIG_marshal
methods.description: Serializes an ECDSA signature into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: ECDSA_SIG_to_bytes
methods.description: Encodes an ECDSA signature into DER bytes.

methods.name: der_len_len
methods.description: Calculates the number of bytes needed to encode a length in DER.

methods.name: ECDSA_SIG_max_len
methods.description: Calculates the maximum length of an ECDSA signature given the order length.

methods.name: d2i_ECDSA_SIG
methods.description: Decodes DER bytes into an ECDSA_SIG structure.

methods.name: i2d_ECDSA_SIG
methods.description: Encodes an ECDSA_SIG structure into DER format.
